purpose: Test whether strictly pre-match home-venue and away-venue scoring/conceding history adds stable Draw information beyond the frozen R39W overall/last5 strength-balance feature family in time-ordered competition-season folds.

folding.train_rule: same-competition rows strictly before the first date of the test season

venue_features.eligibility: home_history_matches>0 and away_history_matches>0 and all required venue/history aggregates finite; baseline and challenger use the identical venue-eligible training rows and identical venue-eligible test rows

models.baseline_draw: R39W frozen 9-feature binary Draw logistic, L2=10, fit on the identical venue-eligible training rows as challenger
models.challenger_draw: baseline 9 features plus 6 frozen venue-specific Draw features, binary logistic L2=10
models.conditional_HA: R39W frozen conditional Home-vs-Away logistic on non-draws, L2=10; identical for baseline and challenger and fit on the same venue-eligible training subset
models.solver: deterministic Newton/IRLS with backtracking line search

frozen_gate.coverage: venue eligible test rows / baseline finite test rows >= 0.95
frozen_gate.fold_draw_log_loss_wins: challenger wins at least 55% of eligible folds
frozen_gate.competition_draw_log_loss_wins: challenger wins at least 60% of competitions with at least two eligible folds
frozen_gate.if_pass: Venue-specific history is a stable incremental Draw information family and may proceed to a separately preregistered confirmation; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Close the venue-history Draw route; no post-result EB/L2/feature/threshold tuning.
